site.name: Son Tra Innovation Fest
site.description: Son Tra Innovation Fest 2026 — three days of technology, FinTech and sustainable living in Da Nang, 2–4 October. Free entry.

home.exploreSubtitle: Three days, one waterfront. Here is where to start.
home.exploreAgenda: Talks, panels and workshops across all three days.
home.exploreExhibition: Meet the startups, labs and makers on the show floor.
home.exploreLocation: Getting there, parking and opening hours.
home.exploreSponsors: The partners making the festival possible.
home.ctaTitle: Free to attend. No ticket required.
home.ctaBody: Plan your days, pick your sessions and bring a friend.

attend.title: Why Attend?
attend.audienceLead: Four kinds of people show up to Son Tra Innovation Fest. Pick the one closest to you to see what to prepare and where to start.
attend.entryFree: Entry is free. No registration or ticket required.

solo.title: Visiting on your own
solo.description: You come when it suits you, set your own route and stop wherever it gets interesting.
solo.highlights:
Walk in freely — no registration needed
A suggested 60-minute route for first-timers
Hands-on zones open all day
Talks and demos need no seat booking

school.title: Coming with a school group
school.description: A class, club or student delegation arriving together, needing a time slot and a guide.
school.highlights:
Groups of 15+ should register for a time slot
Volunteer guides walk your group through the route
Meeting point, bag drop and assembly area for groups
Activity sheets for students

company.title: Attending as a company
company.description: Businesses looking for partners, talent and technology they can put to work.
company.highlights:
Meet the startups and research teams exhibiting
Afternoon business matchmaking session
Book a booth for the next edition
Partnership and sponsorship packages

press.title: Press and media
press.description: Reporters and content creators covering the festival.
press.highlights:
Apply for a press pass before the event date
Press kit with logos and high-resolution images
Dedicated interview and photo area
A direct contact on the organising team
